jobs.title: Senior PMT
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.  

  

As a Senior Product Manager\-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data\-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Own the product vision and multi\-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data\-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies  

  

2\. Make trade\-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace\-specific vs. global calibration)
  

  

3\. Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection  

  

4\. Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high\-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms  

  

5\. Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions  

  

6\. Author the long\-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross\-functional stakeholders

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight

**Description**
 Our mission is to ensure customers trust Amazon to deliver a perfect order experience on every order. The Order Performance team within Perfect Order Experience (POE) is responsible for setting performance standards and ensuring that every purchase in our stores meets or exceeds Amazon's high bar for fulfillment quality and customer service quality — regardless of seller or channel. For our external selling partners, we set minimum performance expectations and enforce those expectations by limiting selling privileges if needed, while incentivizing sellers to improve performance and address customer pain points.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager\-Tech for Enforcement Decisioning, you will own the logic that determines when enforcement triggers — the threshold framework that translates seller performance metrics into enforcement decisions across all Order Performance policies and all global marketplaces. You will build intelligent, data\-driven decisioning that calibrates enforcement to the tradeoff between customer harm prevented and seller value lost. You will also own the criteria for exemptions, leniency, and permanent enforcement, determining which sellers deserve differentiated treatment. You will partner with data scientists, software engineers, policy teams, and operations stakeholders to define the vision, design experiments, and ship decisioning systems that reduce order defects for hundreds of millions of customers while preserving the seller value that drives Amazon's flywheel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the product vision and multi\-year roadmap for enforcement decisioning, including data\-driven threshold models, exemption frameworks, permanent enforcement pathways, and graduated enforcement calibration across multiple fulfillment quality policies
* Make trade\-off decisions across enforcement model design (segmentation, economic tradeoff curves, marketplace\-specific vs. global calibration)
* Design and launch enforcement decisioning systems that maximize defect prevention while minimizing unnecessary enforcement of valuable selection
* Design exemption and leniency logic — including thresholds for high\-value listings, enforcement leniency for sellers with sustained clean performance, and graduated protection mechanisms
* Run A/B and holdout experiments to measure the causal impact of threshold changes on customer experience and business metrics— translating experimental results into production rollout decisions
* Author the long\-term enforcement strategy and present to senior leadership, contributing to annual planning cycles and writing strategy documents that align cross\-functional stakeholders

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

* Implement and monitor automated functional, regression, smoke, and performance test suites for web applications and RESTful services.
* Configure, run, and monitor test execution in cloud and containerized environments (Docker, cloud hosted runners).
* Conduct performance and load testing to identify bottlenecks and validate application scalability. Develop test strategies, plans, and cases that ensure thorough coverage across functional, integration, and API layers.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and drive shift\-left quality practices.
* Coordinate with development and deployment teams to triage defects, resolve issues, and enable bug\-free product releases. Generate and present sprint\-level summary reports (Allure, HTML reports) highlighting test results, coverage, flakiness, and improvement areas.

We are seeking a Manager, Software Development to lead a team of engineers delivering against the roadmap for their initiative. This is a working leadership role that requires hands\-on technical involvement alongside people management, delivery quality, and day\-to\-day technical judgment calls.

****Principal Business Systems Analyst****
**This role is** 
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
 Oracle Fusion Finance Systems Analyst (RTR)
   

  

 Cornerstone is seeking a Oracle Fusion Finance Systems Analyst with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Financials and Oracle Fusion Tax to support and enhance end\-to\-end Financials and tax\-related business processes. This role will own the functional configuration, production support, and continuous improvement of core financial and tax modules while leveraging Oracle Fusion’s embedded AI and intelligent automation capabilities to improve accuracy, compliance, efficiency, and business insight.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will partner closely with Finance and Tax stakeholders to ensure Oracle Fusion Financials and Tax configurations meet regulatory, statutory, and business requirements across global operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Define, design, and continuously improve Oracle Fusion Financial and Tax solutions that deliver end\-to\-end business value and maximize user adoption.
   

  

 Act as a functional subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion Tax, owning tax configuration and ensuring alignment with global and regional tax business needs.
   

  

 Partner with Finance and Tax stakeholders (domestic and global) to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Fusion configurations and solutions.
   

  

 Configure and maintain Oracle Fusion Tax to support business requirements, including Tax regimes, taxes, tax statuses, tax rates, tax rules, Transaction tax determination and reporting
   

  

 Ensure accurate tax calculation, accounting, and reporting across Payables, Receivables, Expenses, and other integrated modules.
   

  

 Support testing, validation, and reconciliation activities, including period close and audit support.
   

  

 Collaborate with third\-party tax solutions (e.g., Avalara) and manage related integrations.
   

  

 Provide day\-to\-day production support for Oracle Fusion Financials and Tax, troubleshooting user\-reported issues and leading root cause analysis.
   

  

 Support enhancements, regulatory updates, and new feature rollouts across the Oracle Fusion platform.
   

  

 Enable and support AI\-driven and intelligent features within Oracle Fusion Financials and Tax, including:
   

  

 Intelligent transaction coding and account combination suggestions
   

  

 Automated tax determination and exception handling
   

  

 Predictive cash forecasting and intelligent close insights
   

  

 Anomaly detection, variance analysis, and automated reconciliations
   

  

 Drive user adoption of AI\-powered analytics and insights to improve tax accuracy, compliance, and financial close efficiency.
   

  

 Develop and maintain BIP and OTBI reports for financial and tax reporting.
   

  

 Create and maintain detailed SOPs, functional design documents, process flows, and end\-user training materials.
   

  

 Lead review, testing, and validation of quarterly Oracle Fusion upgrades, with specific focus on Financials and Tax impact.
   

  

 Support inbound and outbound integrations related to Fusion Financials, including tax engines and external systems.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 8\+ years of hands\-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, including General Ledger, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, Accounts Payable, Expenses, Chart of Accounts (COA) Management, Oracle Fusion Tax
   

  

 Experience with additional modules such as Procurement, Revenue Management, Subscriptions, or Collections is a strong plus.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience configuring Oracle Fusion Financials and Tax, including documentation of functional setups.

jobs.description:
**About Metaforms**


At Metaforms, we're redefining how market research gets done.


Metaforms is an agentic operating system that embeds AI agents into every stage of the research workflow — drafting questionnaires, programming surveys, testing links, managing revisions and trackers, validating data, cleaning and coding open ends, generating tables, and preparing reports — all within a unified, context\-aware platform. We integrate with teams' existing tools, templates, and review processes, and support all major survey platforms including Decipher, Confirmit, Qualtrics, and Dimensions.


Research professionals delegate execution to AI agents while retaining full judgment and oversight, with outputs continuously improving through rules and templates derived from team feedback. Agencies like Dynata, Savanta, and Borderless Access use Metaforms to deliver more projects with less effort.

* **1,000\+ surveys** processed on our platform every month
* Trusted by agencies serving **Fortune 500 companies**
* **Rapid month\-over\-month growth** across customers and volume
* **$9M Series A** raised to aggressively scale the team and product

 **The Role**


We're hiring a **User Experience Designer** to translate complex market research workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces that help users work seamlessly with AI agents.


This is a genuinely hard and interesting design problem. Our users are research professionals delegating real production work to AI — which means every interface must balance automation with oversight, make agent behavior legible and trustworthy, and introduce fundamentally new workflows while still feeling familiar to teams with deeply ingrained ways of working. There are no established design patterns to copy here; you'll be defining how humans and AI agents collaborate on high\-stakes operational work.


You'll own the design process end to end — from user research through prototyping to shipped interfaces — working closely with product, engineering, and research operations in a fast\-moving, product\-driven environment.

 **What You'll Do**

*Research \& Discovery*

* Conduct user research with research operators, project managers, and survey programmers to understand how work actually happens
* Facilitate design thinking workshops to define problems, align stakeholders, and explore solution spaces
* Define user journeys that map where AI agents act, where humans review, and where trust is built or broken

*Design \& Prototyping*

* Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, and detailed design specifications for web\-based products and internal tools
* Design interaction patterns for human\-AI collaboration — review loops, agent output validation, exception handling — that reduce friction without reducing control
* Iterate rapidly based on user feedback, usability testing, and real production usage

*Systems \& Collaboration*

* Contribute to visual design standards and help maintain a consistent, scalable design system
* Ensure accessibility and usability across the Metaforms product suite
* Partner closely with product management and engineering to gather requirements, validate solutions, and see designs through to shipped quality — presenting and defending design decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike

 **What We're Looking For**

*Must\-have*

* Proven experience applying **design thinking and user research** to understand problems, define user needs, and validate solutions
* Strong **UX design fundamentals** — information architecture, interaction design, and user flows for complex, workflow\-heavy products
* Solid **visual design** skills, with the ability to create clean, consistent, accessible interfaces aligned with a design system
* Fluency in **prototyping** in the product’s code base using in\-house and external prototyping tools
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in cross\-functional, product\-driven environments
* Experience designing **B2B SaaS or workflow tools**, especially for operations teams or expert users
* Exposure to **AI\-driven products** — particularly human\-in\-the\-loop or agent\-based experiences

*Nice\-to\-have*

* Experience with onboarding and
* Familiarity with market research, survey tooling, or adjacent data\-heavy domains

 **Why Join Metaforms**

* **Design an entirely new category** of human\-AI collaboration — no templates to copy, real patterns to invent
* Your designs ship the same week into **real production environments** used daily by leading global market research teams
* Work with a high\-agency team where design, product, engineering, and domain expertise are tightly coupled
* **Zero bureaucracy** — fast iteration loops and direct influence on what gets built
* Join a **Series A funded company** at the steepest part of its growth curve

 **Benefits**

* Full family health insurance
* $1,000 USD annual reimbursement for skill development
* Free snacks and dinner at the office
* Monthly food and snacks allowance

**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of next\-generation compliance technology solutions across traditional payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and AI\-enabled compliance capabilities.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Compliance, Product and Technology driving the development of platforms that enable scalable compliance controls while supporting business growth and innovation. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in Financial Crime Compliance (AML, Sanctions, KYC, Transaction Monitoring), strong knowledge of Crypto and Stablecoin ecosystems, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform compliance operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Product Strategy \& Ownership:
   

  

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Compliance Technology platforms.
* Drive product innovation across AML, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Case Management, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Develop scalable compliance solutions supporting both traditional payment rails and digital asset ecosystems.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.


**Financial Crime Compliance**
* Translate regulatory requirements into product features and technical capabilities.
* Design and enhance controls supporting:
+ AML/CFT
+ Sanctions Screening
+ KYC/KYB \& Customer Due Diligence
+ Transaction Monitoring
+ Enhanced Due Diligence
+ Regulatory Reporting
+ Case Management \& Investigations

* Collaborate with Compliance Operations teams to optimise alert management and investigation workflows.


**Crypto \& Stablecoin Compliance**
* Lead compliance technology initiatives supporting stablecoin\-enabled payment products and digital asset ecosystems.
* Design controls for:
+ Blockchain analytics
+ Wallet screening
+ On\-chain transaction monitoring
+ Travel Rule compliance
+ Crypto onboarding and risk assessment
+ Stablecoin transaction monitoring

* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to embed compliance controls within digital asset products and services.
* Evaluate emerging regulatory frameworks and assess impacts on product and technology strategies.


**AI \& Emerging Technologies**
* Champion the application of AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Automation across compliance programs.
* Develop AI governance, explainability, and model oversight requirements in partnership with Compliance and Risk teams.
* Evaluate AI vendors and emerging technologies to strengthen compliance capabilities.


**Technical Product Delivery**
* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
* Lead integrations with internal platforms and external providers.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, UAT, production validation, and release planning.
* Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and enable data\-driven decisions.


**Stakeholder Leadership**
* Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Commercial teams.
* Lead requirement workshops, design reviews, and governance forums.
* Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global teams.
* Present strategy, roadmap progress, and key decisions to executives and leadership teams.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Compliance Technology, FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services.
* Deep understanding of:
+ AML/CFT frameworks
+ Sanctions Compliance
+ Customer Due Diligence
+ Transaction Monitoring
+ Financial Crime Investigations

* Experience delivering enterprise\-scale compliance technology solutions.
* Strong knowledge of payments, money movement, and fintech ecosystems.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Crypto, Digital Assets, Stablecoins, Blockchain Analytics, or Travel Rule solutions.
* Knowledge of stablecoin regulatory frameworks and compliance controls.
* Experience implementing AI/ML\-enabled compliance solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data architecture, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022, ISO 8583, and modern payment architectures.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.
 



  





**Being a Creator** 
 :
 



 Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically?
 



 Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation.

 \- Payments
* *Technology*

 \- CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors

**Apply if you have :** 



1. Aspiration for value creation
2. Aspiration for quality
3. Genuine user empathy
4. Openness and patience to learn harder things
5. Systematic approach to problem solving
6. Attitude and ability to get\-things\-done
7. Effectively balance big picture / details
8. Self\-motivated and driven
9. Persuasive without being forceful
10. The Giver attitude

* MBA with 1\-3 years of professional experience in Product Management.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams



  





**Why work in Juspay?** 




  





***Payments.. big deal?***




 Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments \- India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve!
 



  





***How can Engineering solve this?***




 Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it.

 You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We have a full size piano, drums and a Shruti box if you are into music :) Lots of books, pictionary and interesting people to talk to about varied subjects \- art, philosophy and of course about how to do the highest feats of engineering/design. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
 Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 
   

  

 BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock. 
   

  

 We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
 



 Senior Product Managers at Blink are innovators, craftspeople and business thinkers. Your job as a Sr Product Manager is to take ownership over our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you’ll grow our business, build our core platform, and \- above all \- make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth.  
 



 At Blink, we determine the specific focus of product roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: our telemedicine platform; our home delivery experience; our growth team; our core cloud pharmacy platform; new product line development and strategic platforms. We’ll work with you to find the right fit. All PM roles include driving product strategy, roadmapping, rapid testing and research, release planning, experimentation and analysis. PMs are expected to become true experts in pharmacy systems \- so that we can transform them. And they are expected to become experts in our customers \- so that we can provide a truly unparalleled experience to them.
 



 While this role is based in India, you will work on global products that require partnership with teams across regions. We are also aggressively growing our teams in India and this role will be one of our founding product based roles here.
 



**About You** 



* Experienced \- you have 6\+ years as a product manager, either with strong consumer or deep platform experience.
* Proven Builder \- you have delivered multiple successful and innovative products from ‘0 to 1 to n’. You can point directly to growth/engagement/success metrics on these products.
* Consumer\-Obsessed \- you always think first about the consumer, hunt for empathy, and do everything possible to give the customer the best possible experience.
* Analytical \- you naturally break hard problems into their pieces, are deeply familiar with best\-in\-class experimentation practices, use key results to drive strategies, and basically just measure everything.
* Driven and Biased\-to\-Action \- you can manage through complexity, lead with influence, make hard decisions, and persevere when things are challenging. You are hungry to win and you have the grit to make it happen.
* Collaborative and Communicative \- you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class\-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct.
* Technical \- an engineering background/skills are highly preferred for Product roles at Blink. You will work closely with engineering teams and will need to appreciate technical nuances of the solutions being built.
* BE/B Tech degree from top institution; MBA or Computer Science degree preferred but not mandatory.



**Why Join Us:**
 It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
 As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is
   

  

 important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in\-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product.  You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

 **Support Marketplace Portal (Seller Central)** 
 in connecting with enterprise systems, delivering end to end experience for third party sellers to run their business on Target.com. You will be responsible for addressing Partner pain points across our APIs, and various points of connection and interaction. You will implement compliance, scalability and other key initiatives that help us drive our business as one of the top growth levers for Target.
   

  

**About You**
* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience

* Strong communication skills


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to solve complex workflow and system challenges
* Experience in building 0\-1 products, A/B Testing and finding product market fit
* Ability to work with both technical and non\-technical teams to drive alignment
* MBA preferred


 Why Join Us
   

  

* Be at the forefront of building a scalable marketplace ecosystem
* Work on high\-impact initiatives connecting enterprise systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance partner experiences

jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

**Company:** MrMed  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka \| **Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Experience:** 10\+ Years  
**Reports To:** Founders

About MrMed

MrMed is a technology\-driven specialty healthcare platform helping patients across India access critical and specialty medicines.

We operate at the intersection of **Healthcare, Technology, E\-commerce and Customer Experience**, where technology directly impacts how quickly and reliably patients receive the medicines they need.

As we continue to scale, we are looking for a **Chief Technology Officer who thinks beyond technology** \- someone who understands customers, business, products, numbers and execution.

The Opportunity

This is **not a traditional CTO role**.

We are looking for a **technology entrepreneur, builder and business owner at heart**.

Someone who does not simply wait for a product requirement, assign it to a team and track delivery.

We want someone who can look at a business problem and say:

**"I can build something to solve this."**

You should have the mindset of someone who has **built a product, launched an app, started something of your own, experimented with a business idea, or operated with strong founder\-level ownership inside a startup.**

You will own **Technology and Product**, work closely with the Founders, understand business priorities and convert opportunities into scalable products and technology solutions.

This role requires someone who is comfortable moving between:

**Business → Customer → Product → Technology → Execution → Outcomes**

You will not just build technology for the business.

**You will help build the business through technology.**

What You Will Own1\. Product \& Technology Strategy

* Own the overall Product and Technology roadmap in line with business goals.
* Understand customer problems and convert them into simple, scalable product solutions.
* Work closely with the Founders to identify opportunities where technology can improve revenue, customer experience, efficiency and scalability.
* Balance speed, quality, cost and long\-term technology decisions.
* Build products that solve real customer and business problems, not technology for the sake of technology.

2\. Build Like an Entrepreneur

We are particularly looking for someone with a **builder's mindset**.

You should:

* Have built an app, product, platform, startup or technology solution from scratch.
* Be comfortable taking an idea from **0 → 1**.
* Enjoy experimenting, testing, failing fast and improving quickly.
* Think about business outcomes, not just technical output.
* Be comfortable working with incomplete information and taking decisions.
* Identify problems without waiting for someone to tell you what to solve.
* Take complete ownership from idea to execution to outcome.
* Understand that sometimes the best solution is not the most complicated technology.

**If you have tried building your own startup, app, SaaS product, marketplace or consumer product, we would especially like to hear about it.**

3\. Business \& Commercial Thinking

Technology at MrMed is expected to create measurable business value.

You will:

* Understand revenue, customer acquisition, retention, conversion, margins and operational efficiency.
* Work with the Founders to identify technology\-led growth opportunities.
* Partner with Business, Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance and other teams.
* Evaluate build vs buy decisions from both technology and business perspectives.
* Use data to make product and technology decisions.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
* Think about technology investment in terms of **business impact and ROI**.

4\. Engineering Leadership

* Lead the overall engineering organisation across Backend, Frontend, Mobile, QA, DevOps, Cloud, Security and Infrastructure.
* Define scalable architecture and engineering standards.
* Ensure technology systems are secure, reliable and scalable.
* Establish strong engineering practices, coding standards, testing and deployment processes.
* Improve engineering productivity and delivery predictability.
* Build systems that can support MrMed's next stage of growth.

5\. AI \& Innovation

AI will be an important part of our technology journey.

You will:

* Identify practical use cases for Generative AI, LLMs and AI Agents.
* Explore how AI can improve customer experience, operations, product development and engineering productivity.
* Build and test AI\-led products rather than simply following technology trends.
* Encourage experimentation while maintaining business discipline.
* Help MrMed identify where AI can create a genuine competitive advantage.

6\. People \& Leadership

You will build and lead a high\-performing technology organisation.

This includes:

* Hiring strong engineering and product talent.
* Building future technology leaders.
* Setting clear expectations and accountability.
* Creating a culture of ownership and problem\-solving.
* Coaching managers and senior engineers.
* Developing strong technical and product capabilities within the team.
* Ensuring the team understands **why** they are building something, not just **what** they are building.

We want a leader who can create a team where people **take ownership, challenge assumptions, learn quickly and solve problems together.**

7\. Cross\-Functional Leadership

Technology should not operate as an independent department.

You will work closely with:

* Founders
* Business \& Operations
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Finance
* HR
* Product and Engineering

You should be able to sit in a business discussion, understand the problem, challenge the thinking where required and translate the opportunity into a practical technology solution.

What We're Looking ForMust Have

* **10\+ years of experience** in Software Engineering / Technology, with significant leadership experience.
* Experience leading Engineering and Product team…

**Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)**
---------------------------------------------


**Position Title:** Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance \& Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)  

**Function:** Insurance  

  

**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum


### **Role Summary**



The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.


### **Key Roles \& Responsibilities**


**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**


* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**


* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**


* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**


* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**


* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**


* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

### **Must\-Have Skills**



**Category**  

**Requirement**  


**Domain**  


9  


**Platform**  


Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform  


**Conversion\-specific**  


Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover  


**Data**  


Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)  


**Documentation**  


Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards  


**Delivery**

We're Hiring: Product Manager / Product Owner – Hospital Management Platform (MedOrbit) 
 



  





 This is not a "learn healthcare on the job" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals – we need someone who has owned a real HMS, EMR/EHR, LIS/RIS or healthcare\-claims product and can take a deep platform and make it sharper, better packaged, and easier to sell.
 



  





**Role Details** 




 Position: Product Manager / Product Owner – MedOrbit (HMS \& Healthcare SaaS)
 



 Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (Hybrid, with regular hospital site visits)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 5\+ years in product, with 3\+ years in healthcare software
 



 Reports to: Founders
 



  





 Please apply only if you have already owned a live HMS, EMR/EHR, LIS/RIS, or healthcare\-claims product used by real hospitals or clinics.
 



  





**About MedOrbit** 




 MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi\-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One product serves 24 facility types – from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500\-bed super\-specialty hospital, a pathology lab, an imaging centre, a dialysis chain, a blood bank and a retail pharmacy – sold as 7 commercial editions assembled from 68 licensable modules.
 



  





 It runs the full clinical and operational spine:
 



 → Clinical: OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, dialysis, oncology, transplant, cath lab, IVF, telemedicine, tele\-ICU
 



 → Diagnostics \& pharmacy: LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, pharmacy and e\-pharmacy
 



 → Operations: CSSD, biomedical waste, ambulance, inventory, HR and payroll
 



 → Revenue: billing, revenue\-cycle management, insurance / TPA, GST, government scheme rates
 



  





 It is ABDM\-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4\), NHCX\-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and carries the Indian regulatory surface: CEA registration and licence tracking, PNDT and NDPS registers, NABH/NABL evidence, DPDP consent and DSAR.
 



  





 And it is AI\-native: 11 production agents already run under clinician control – an ambient scribe, pre\-consult briefs, consult summaries with draft prescriptions, a result explainer for patients, referral triage, a claim\-denial guard, a queue concierge, medication reconciliation, and voice agents on the front desk and in aftercare.
 



  





  
 **The Role** 




 You will own the product line end to end – discovery through release – for a platform that is already live with paying facilities.
 



  





 The genuinely hard problem here is not "what feature next." It is productisation: deciding which modules belong in which edition for which facility type, so that a nursing home, a diagnostic centre and a tertiary hospital each receive a product that feels purpose\-built rather than a switched\-off hospital system.
 



  





 You'll also be the product voice in the sales cycle – joining hospital demos, answering the hard workflow questions, shaping proposals and pilots, and turning what you hear in the room into the roadmap.
 



  





 You'll work directly with the founders and the engineering team, and spend real time inside hospitals watching the workflows you're specifying.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 → Roadmap \& prioritisation across the clinical, operational, billing and regulatory module sets – with a clear, defensible ranking rationale
 



 → Edition \& packaging strategy – module\-to\-edition mapping, facility\-type presets, entitlement rules, upgrade paths and the commercial logic behind them
 



 → Clinical \& operational workflows – specifications that a nurse, a lab technician, a radiologist, a front\-desk executive, a pharmacist and a billing clerk each recognise as their actual job (\~114 distinct roles, each with its own menu and permissions)
 



 → Revenue\-cycle depth – patient billing, insurance and TPA, NHCX claims, denial management, government scheme rates (PMJAY / CGHS / ESI), GST
 



 → Regulatory \& compliance requirements – ABDM, NABH/NABL, CEA, PNDT/NDPS, DPDP – translated into buildable, testable acceptance criteria
 



 → AI agent product definition – where an agent is genuinely safe and useful, what a clinician must approve, what gets logged, and how we measure whether it worked
 



 → Sales enablement – join hospital demos and discovery calls, handle workflow and compliance objections, build demo scripts, edition comparisons and pilot proposals, and feed deal learnings back into the backlog
 



 → Customer discovery \& validation – hospital site visits, workflow shadowing, pilot design, and closing the loop from production usage back into the backlog
 



 → Release readiness – UAT with clinical users, migration and data\-cutover planning, rollout sequencing, launch and adoption tracking
 



 → The written record – PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, journey maps and decision logs the team can build from without a follow\-up meeting
 



  





**What You Must Bring** 




 → 3\+ years in product ownership / product management, of which at least 3 are in healthcare software – HMS/HIS, EMR/EHR, LIS, RIS/PACS, practice management, healthcare RCM, or a payer/claims platform
 



 → You have shipped a healthcare product that real clinicians used in production, and can walk us through a workflow you specified, what broke in the field, and what you changed
 



 → Experience supporting sales – you have sat in hospital demos and pre\-sales conversations, handled product questions from administrators and doctors, helped shape proposals or pilots, and know how product decisions win or lose deals
 



 → Fluency in hospital operations – you know what an OPD token queue, an IPD admission\-to\-discharge cycle, an OT schedule, a lab sample\-to\-report chain and a discharge summary actually involve
 



 → Healthcare billing and claims literacy – payer mix, TPA workflows, pre\-authorisation, denial reasons, package rates

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner

 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.

* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.

* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.

+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Manager / Associate Product Manager**
**Turn messy real\-world problems into simple products.**
 AbleCredit builds software for complex enterprise workflows where AI, APIs, business rules, human decisions, and real\-world operations have to work together reliably. We care about building products that work in production \- not just in demos. Our customers don't arrive with clean product requirements. They have operational problems involving people, policies, existing systems, edge cases, and workflows built over years. Product at AbleCredit means understanding that complexity deeply and turning it into reusable, simple product capabilities.
   

  

**What You'll Own?**
* Spend time with customers and internal teams to understand workflows, constraints, and the real problem behind requests.
* Translate ambiguous operational problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering and design from discovery through rollout rather than handing off specifications.
* Prioritize based on customer impact, product strategy, effort, risk, and reuse across customers.
* Define success metrics and evaluate whether shipped products actually improve the workflow.
* Own launches, feedback loops, adoption, and iteration after release.
* Identify patterns across customer requests and turn them into reusable platform capabilities instead of one\-off customizations.
* Maintain clarity on what we are building, why we are building it, and what we deliberately are not building.


**What We're Looking For?**
* 1\-5 years of product, engineering, analytics, consulting, operations, or adjacent experience; level will be calibrated to experience.
* Strong problem decomposition and structured thinking.
* Ability to understand technical systems, APIs, data flows, and constraints well enough to work deeply with engineers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Comfort speaking with customers and asking detailed questions until the underlying workflow is understood.
* Bias toward evidence, prototypes, and shipped outcomes rather than process for its own sake.
* Ability to operate with ambiguity and make sensible trade\-offs.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, workflow products, fintech, or AI\-assisted products.
* Technical background or prior engineering experience.
* Experience working with APIs, integrations, analytics, or operational products.
* Experience taking a product from discovery through adoption.


**How Product Works Here?**
 Product managers are expected to understand the problem deeply, not act as ticket routers. The best solution may be a new feature, a platform primitive, a workflow change, an API, or deciding not to build something. Success is measured by customer and product outcomes, not PRD volume.
   

  

 Skills:\- Product Management, Product Discovery, Problem Definition, Requirement Analysis, Problem Decomposition, Structured Thinking, User Research, Customer Research, Customer Workflow Understanding, Product Strategy, Prioritization, User Journey, Workflow Mapping, Product Requirement Documentation, Wireframing, Prototyping, Data\-Driven Decision, Product Metrics, Success Metrics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, A/B Testing, Agile/Scrum, Stakeholder management, Collaboration, Product launch, Adoption, Feedback Loops, Iteration, Enterprise Product Management and Workflow Product Management
